dialogues.speaker: Read
dialogues.text: Some letters lie scattered on the table...

response.speaker: Letter From Emilie
response.text: "...Thank you, Ms. Chiori, for your feedback on the fragrances. I've placed a sample of my newest product in this letter. It's a recent experiment with a Romaritime fragrance..."

response.speaker: Letter From Emilie
response.text: "Also, about the schedule for the next test..."

response.speaker: Letter From Navia
response.text: "It's a Spina party this evening, and you're invited!"

response.speaker: Letter From Navia
response.text: "P.S.: Rope Eloffe in as well, would you?"

response.speaker: Letter From Kirara
response.text: "Someone asked about my clothes and where I got them while I was on a delivery run, Chiori. They said they wanted a set for their daughter."

response.speaker: Letter From Kirara
response.text: "I've attached the kid's sizes and a photo here. I'll drop by your store to pick it up next time I'm in town!"

response.speaker: Letter From Chevreuse
response.text: "...The Gardes suspect the judge... clandestine illicit deal."

response.speaker: Letter From Chevreuse
response.text: "...His wife... a regular customer at your store. Please keep an eye out."
